create_smooth_labels: create smoothed label distributions by applying label smoothing to one-hot encoded labels
compute_categorical_kl_divergence: compute KL divergence between two categorical distributions from their logits with optional temperature scaling
compute_cross_entropy_label_smoothing_lo: compute cross entropy loss with label smoothing and optional masking over logits and labels
compute_date_loss_l2: compute L2 loss for date predictions with min/max boundary penalties and masking
compute_date_loss_l1: compute L1 loss for date predictions with min/max boundary penalties and masking
